text:
alex_onboard: FYI LyonsClinic returned the vendor intake. Main asks: BYOK support, key provenance attestation, and where embeddings/vector stores may be hosted. Procurement wants answers by Fri COB.

maya_cs: Uploaded the intake (lyons_vendor_packet.pdf). They're particularly nervous about PHI in embeddings.

dan_se: Quick note: we support customer-managed keys only on Dedicated and Private right now. Hosted keys are Redwood-managed; no BYOK for hosted.

priya_security: Can we provide a one-paragraph attestation confirming that Dedicated supports customer KMS and summarizing our rotation policy + evidence links?

ops_bot: Created ticket CS-4789 and assigned to @priya_security. Due 2026-04-03.

sam_sre: For embeddings residency: derivative artifacts may be stored in the region of the serving pool handling the request. For Hosted, that can be multiple regions depending on routing; Dedicated/Private are pinned.

alex_onboard: LyonsClinic specifically asked: "If we bring PHI, can you guarantee embeddings won't leave EU?" Any short answer?

dan_se: For Hosted: cannot guarantee single-region residency for derivatives unless they use a region-restricted plan. For Dedicated/Private we can pin region. I'll draft a sentence: "To guarantee EU-only storage of embeddings and indexes, customers should provision a Dedicated or Private deployment in the EU region and enable customer-managed keys."

maya_cs: They'll accept that if we provide steps and config snippets. Procurement also asked for a sample attestation and a contact for an escalation SLA.

priya_security: I'll draft the attestation. Short version: confirm supported KMS integrations (AWS KMS, GCP KMS), state that customer-provided keys are supported on Dedicated/Private, and reference our rotation cadence and SOC2 controls. Will attach a link to the KMS integration guide.

dan_se: Adding a sample config for Dedicated (YAML):
```yaml
deployment_type: dedicated
region: eu-west-1
encryption:
  key_provider: aws-kms
  kms_key_id: arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:999999999:key/abcd-1234
  encryption_mode: customer_managed
embeddings:
  persistence: enabled
  retention_days: 0  # 0 indicates no persistence / ephemerality
```

sam_sre: Note: retention_days:0 is currently gated behind an opt-in flag on hosted and requires a short maintenance window and ops review. For Dedicated/Private it's available immediately.

alex_onboard: Procurement deadline is tight. Can we give them a matrix with 3 rows: Hosted, Dedicated, Private and columns: BYOK supported, Embeddings EU guarantee, Evidence link?

maya_cs: Yes — I'll compile once we have the attestation and config. Can someone confirm exact evidence links?

priya_security: Evidence pointers: 1) KMS integration guide: https://redwood.internal/docs/kms-integration (internal), 2) SOC2 controls summary: https://redwood.internal/compliance/soc2-summary, 3) Dedicated deployment region pinning doc: https://redwood.internal/ops/dedicated-regions. I'll include those in the matrix.

ops_bot: Reminder: CS-4789 due in 24 hours.

dan_se: Also adding a short curl example to request ephemeral embeddings on hosted (experimental):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-embed-1","text":"...","embeddings": {"persist": false}}'
```

maya_cs: Perfect. Priya, once you post the attestation, I'll drop everything into a single PDF and send to Legal + procurement.

priya_security: Posting attestation draft now (uploaded: lyons_attestation_draft.txt). Text: "Redwood supports customer-managed keys for Dedicated and Private deployments via AWS KMS and GCP KMS. Customers control key provenance; Redwood rotates Redwood-managed keys under SOC2 controls and recommends customers rotate BYOK keys per their policy. For questions, contact security@redwood.com."

alex_onboard: Looks good. Two minor edits to the second sentence for clarity, I'll inline comment the file.

maya_cs: Can someone volunteer to be the sender to procurement? I'd rather have CS own that. I'll send it after final edits.

dan_se: I'll resolve the YAML comment and push the matrix to the ticket. Link: https://redwood.internal/triage/CS-4789/matrix (internal).

ops_bot: CS-4789 status: in-progress.

maya_cs: Great teamwork. Plan: 1) Dan finalizes matrix and examples, 2) Priya finalizes attestation, 3) I assemble PDF + cover email and send to LyonsClinic procurement. Aim: this afternoon. :thumbsup:
